description: This topic covers Kiswahili prepositions (vihusishi), conjunctions (viunganishi) and adverbs (vielezi), their types, uses and correct placement in sentences.

mcq.questionText: Kihusishi ni neno linalofanya kazi gani katika sentensi?

options.text: Kuonyesha uhusiano kati ya nomino na maneno mengine

mcq.explanation: A kihusishi (preposition) shows the relationship between a noun and other words, e.g. position, direction or time.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Kitabu kiko juu ya meza', neno 'juu ya' ni la aina gani?
mcq.explanation: 'Juu ya' is a kihusishi (preposition) showing the location of the book relative to the table.

mcq.questionText: Ni neno gani kati ya haya ni kiunganishi?
mcq.explanation: 'Lakini' (but) is a kiunganishi (conjunction) that joins clauses showing contrast.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Aliimba vizuri', neno 'vizuri' ni kielezi cha aina gani?
mcq.explanation: 'Vizuri' tells how the action of singing was done, so it is a kielezi cha namna/jinsi (adverb of manner).

mcq.questionText: Neno 'jana' katika 'Tulifika jana' ni kielezi cha aina gani?
mcq.explanation: 'Jana' (yesterday) tells when the action happened, so it is a kielezi cha wakati (adverb of time).
'Kwa sababu' (because) is a conjunction that introduces a reason.

mcq.questionText: Katika 'Atasoma kwa bidii ili afaulu', neno 'ili' linaonyesha nini?
mcq.explanation: 'Ili' (so that / in order to) is a conjunction showing purpose or goal.

mcq.questionText: Neno 'mpaka' katika 'Alikimbia mpaka sokoni' linafanya kazi gani?
mcq.explanation: Here 'mpaka' (up to / until) acts as a kihusishi showing the end point of the action.

mcq.questionText: Ni sentensi gani inayotumia kiunganishi cha kuchagua (au)?

options.text: Nilikula kwa sababu nilikuwa na njaa

mcq.explanation: 'Au' (or) is a conjunction offering a choice between alternatives.

mcq.questionText: Katika 'Watoto wengi walicheza', neno 'wengi' ni kielezi cha aina gani?
mcq.explanation: 'Wengi' indicates quantity/number, functioning as a kielezi cha idadi/kiasi.

mcq.questionText: Neno gani ni kihusishi cha asili/chanzo (kuonyesha mahali kitu kilipotoka)?
mcq.explanation: 'Toka' (from) is a preposition showing the source or starting point.

mcq.questionText: Katika 'Alisoma ingawa alikuwa mgonjwa', kiunganishi 'ingawa' kinaonyesha nini?
mcq.explanation: 'Ingawa' (although) shows contrast or concession between the two clauses.

mcq.questionText: Ni neno gani kati ya haya ni kielezi cha mahali?
mcq.explanation: 'Huku' (here / this side) is a kielezi cha mahali (adverb of place).

mcq.questionText: Katika 'Mama na baba walisafiri', neno 'na' linafanya kazi gani?
mcq.explanation: Here 'na' (and) is a kiunganishi joining the two nouns 'mama' and 'baba'.

mcq.questionText: Ni sentensi gani ambayo kielezi kimewekwa mahali sahihi baada ya kitenzi?
mcq.explanation: Adverbs of manner like 'polepole' usually follow the verb, giving the natural order 'Mtoto anatembea polepole'.

fib.questionText: Neno linaloonyesha uhusiano kati ya nomino na maneno mengine huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A word that shows the relationship between a noun and other words is a kihusishi (preposition).

fib.questionText: Neno linalounganisha maneno au sentensi huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A word that joins words or sentences is a kiunganishi (conjunction).

fib.questionText: Neno linaloeleza zaidi kuhusu kitendo, kama vile namna, mahali au wakati, huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A word that gives more detail about a verb (manner, place, time) is a kielezi (adverb).

fib.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Aliingia _____ chumbani', jaza kihusishi kinachofaa cha mahali.
fib.explanation: 'Katika' (in/into) is a preposition of place suitable here: 'Aliingia katika chumbani'.
'Kwa sababu' (because) is the conjunction that introduces a reason.

fib.questionText: Katika 'Tutakutana _____ saa nne', jaza kihusishi cha wakati kinachofaa.
fib.explanation: Time expressions often use 'saa' directly; an acceptable answer is the preposition-like phrase. Here 'saa nne' marks the time of meeting.
'Haraka' (quickly) tells how an action is done, so it is a kielezi cha namna/jinsi.

fib.questionText: Katika 'Nilisafiri _____ Dodoma hadi Mwanza', jaza kihusishi cha chanzo.
fib.explanation: 'Kutoka' (from) marks the starting point: 'kutoka Dodoma hadi Mwanza'.

fib.questionText: Kiunganishi kinachoonyesha lengo au madhumuni ni '_____'.
fib.explanation: 'Ili' (so that / in order to) is the conjunction expressing purpose.

fib.questionText: Katika 'Alikaa _____ ya wazazi wake', jaza kihusishi kinachoonyesha kuwa kati ya watu wawili.
fib.explanation: 'Kati ya' (between) shows position between two parties: 'kati ya wazazi wake'.

tf.questionText: Vihusishi huonyesha uhusiano kati ya nomino na maneno mengine katika sentensi.
tf.explanation: True. This is the defining function of vihusishi (prepositions).
False. 'Lakini' (but) is a kiunganishi (conjunction), not an adverb.

tf.questionText: Kielezi cha wakati huonyesha wakati kitendo kilipotendeka, kama vile 'jana' na 'kesho'.
tf.explanation: True. 'Jana' and 'kesho' are vielezi vya wakati (adverbs of time).

tf.questionText: Kiunganishi 'na' kinaweza kuunganisha nomino mbili katika sentensi.
tf.explanation: True. 'Na' joins items, e.g. 'mama na baba'.
False. 'Katika' is a kihusishi (preposition) of place, not a conjunction.

tf.questionText: Vielezi vya idadi huonyesha wingi au kiasi cha kitu, kama vile 'wengi' na 'kidogo'.
tf.explanation: True. Such words express number or quantity (vielezi vya idadi/kiasi).
False. 'Ili' shows purpose/goal, while 'kwa sababu' shows reason.

tf.questionText: Kielezi cha namna kwa kawaida huwekwa baada ya kitenzi katika sentensi.
tf.explanation: True. Adverbs of manner such as 'vizuri' or 'polepole' usually follow the verb.

tf.questionText: Neno 'mpaka' linaweza kufanya kazi ya kihusishi kuonyesha mwisho wa safari au wakati.
tf.explanation: True. 'Mpaka' (up to/until) can act as a preposition marking an end point.

tf.questionText: Kiunganishi 'ingawa' na 'lakini' vyote huonyesha kinyume au upingamizi.

summary.questionText: Eleza kwa ufupi maana ya kihusishi na utoe mfano mmoja.
summary.correctAnswer: Kihusishi ni neno linaloonyesha uhusiano kati ya nomino na maneno mengine, mfano: katika, kwa, hadi.
summary.explanation: A kihusishi (preposition) links a noun to other words, showing place, time or direction; examples include katika, kwa, hadi.

summary.questionText: Eleza kazi kuu ya kiunganishi katika sentensi.
summary.correctAnswer: Kiunganishi huunganisha maneno, vikundi vya maneno au sentensi mbili au zaidi.
summary.explanation: Conjunctions connect words, phrases or clauses, e.g. na, lakini, au, kwa sababu.

summary.correctAnswer: Vielezi vya namna/jinsi, vya mahali, vya wakati, vya kiasi, na vya idadi.
summary.explanation: The main types of adverbs are of manner, place, time, degree/quantity and number.

summary.questionText: Toa mifano miwili ya vihusishi vya mahali.
summary.correctAnswer: Mfano: katika, juu ya, chini ya, ndani ya, kati ya.
summary.explanation: Prepositions of place include katika, juu ya, chini ya, ndani ya and kati ya.

summary.questionText: Eleza tofauti kati ya kiunganishi 'kwa sababu' na 'ili'.
summary.correctAnswer: 'Kwa sababu' huonyesha sababu, na 'ili' huonyesha lengo au madhumuni.
summary.explanation: 'Kwa sababu' gives a reason, while 'ili' expresses purpose.

summary.questionText: Andika sentensi moja inayotumia kielezi cha wakati.
summary.explanation: A correct answer includes a time adverb such as kesho, e.g. 'Tutasafiri kesho asubuhi'.

summary.questionText: Eleza nafasi ya kawaida ya kielezi cha namna katika sentensi.
summary.correctAnswer: Kielezi cha namna kwa kawaida huwekwa baada ya kitenzi.
summary.explanation: Adverbs of manner normally come after the verb, e.g. 'Aliimba vizuri'.

summary.questionText: Toa mifano miwili ya viunganishi vinavyoonyesha kinyume.
summary.explanation: Conjunctions of contrast include lakini, ila and ingawa.

summary.questionText: Eleza tofauti kati ya kihusishi na kiunganishi.
summary.correctAnswer: Kihusishi huonyesha uhusiano wa nomino na maneno mengine; kiunganishi huunganisha maneno au sentensi.
summary.explanation: A preposition relates a noun to other words, while a conjunction joins words or sentences together.

summary.questionText: Andika sentensi moja inayotumia kihusishi 'kati ya'.
summary.correctAnswer: Mfano: Mtoto alikaa kati ya wazazi wake.
summary.explanation: A correct answer uses 'kati ya' (between) to show position, e.g. 'Mtoto alikaa kati ya wazazi wake'.

hoq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Alisoma kwa bidii ili afaulu, lakini hakufanikiwa kwa sababu aliugua', ni maneno gani ni viunganishi?
hoq.explanation: The conjunctions are 'ili' (purpose), 'lakini' (contrast) and 'kwa sababu' (reason); 'kwa bidii' here is an adverbial phrase of manner, not a conjunction.

hoq.questionText: Chagua sentensi ambayo maneno yote yaliyopigiwa mstari yametumiwa kwa usahihi: kihusishi, kiunganishi na kielezi mtawalia.

options.text: Aliingia katika chumba na akaketi polepole
Aliingia polepole chumba katika akaketi na
Aliingia na chumba katika polepole akaketi
Aliingia chumba polepole na katika akaketi

hoq.explanation: Only option a is grammatical: 'katika' (kihusishi) precedes the noun, 'na' (kiunganishi) joins the clauses, and 'polepole' (kielezi) follows the verb.

hoq.questionText: Katika 'Watoto wengi walicheza vizuri uwanjani jana', panga maneno 'wengi', 'vizuri', 'uwanjani' na 'jana' kulingana na aina za vielezi kwa mpangilio: idadi, namna, mahali, wakati.
hoq.explanation: 'Wengi' = idadi (number), 'vizuri' = namna (manner), 'uwanjani' = mahali (place), 'jana' = wakati (time), matching the required order.
